findings.problem: The example has no conjugated verb, which every example must have.
findings.fix: example.es: Tienes que seguir las reglas. example.en: You have to follow the rules.

back.es: la regla: rule (also ruler, and colloquially a menstrual period)

note: Norma can also mean rule, but regla is the everyday default, so the prompt needs no hint.
